adaptations: Original detailed cabin, BMW badge and dashboard texture atlases retained. Source duplicate interior assembly removed; complete second assembly retained.
Vehicle uses source M Sport styling and source wheel design; exact stock xDrive20i bumper and wheel configuration not claimed.
Dimensions corrected using body shell width separately from mirrors; axles aligned to 2.810 m. Tires/rims uniformly scaled locally to preserve roundness.
Missing game vehiclelights128 replaced by neutral white headlight/red tail-lamp PBR colors; source lamp geometry retained, modeled reflectors exposed.
Chrome kidney outlines selected from existing connected geometry; black vertical slats retained. No replacement badge logos generated.
35d portion of front-door badge removed by isolated letter region; xDrive retained. Single approximate open oval chrome outlet placed vehicle-left, connected by a dark pipe to existing underbody.
Axle positions follow official BMW drawing: 861mm front and1000mm rear overhang. Both mirror assemblies moved inboard24.36mm; body width unchanged. Nominal19-inch622M tire outer radius~351.5mm.
Original author plate retained as visible source attribution. Reflection/game materials adapted to PBR; appearance is a reconstruction, not CAD.
remaining_differences: The owner’s exact bumper package, wheels, upholstery, steering side and optional equipment have not been established. Source M Sport bodywork, wheel design and original cabin remain reference choices.
The xDrive35d engine letters were removed; the xDrive text remains. The single vehicle-left oval chrome exhaust and connector are reconstructed approximations of the documented xDrive20i layout.

Game materials were adapted to physically based web rendering. Missing shared lamp texture was replaced with material colours while preserving the original lamp geometry. Paint swatches are screen approximations.
The original contributor plate is retained. Visual part explosion separates model meshes and is not a mechanical service procedure.
